# CreateSpace

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Creates an empty space.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x04` SVC_CREATE | `OBJECT_SPACE (1)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Handle CreateSpace(const char *name);
```

**Registers:** `(name, len) -> r0 space handle or error`

Fill it with MemInjectObj() / MemInjectBytes(), then add tasks with CreateTask(). Its maximum priority is the caller's.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | in | Name for diagnostics; truncated to 31 characters. |

## Returns

A space handle with all permissions, or a negative error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADPTR`](../errors.md#err_badptr) | `name` is not readable memory. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../errors.md#err_nomem) | Out of kernel memory, or the caller's handle table is full. |
